about.lead_bold: JapanSSW is your one-stop platform for skilled trade job seekers under the Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visa in Japan.
about.lead: Founded in 2024 by Juan Angelo, JapanSSW provides job matching, visa guidance, and community resources to help foreign workers find stable employment and build better futures in Japan.
rso.title: ASEAN PLUS
rso.lead: ASEAN PLUS (ASEAN+3) brings together the 10 ASEAN member states with China, Japan and South Korea to deepen regional cooperation across trade, labour, education and social services — including programmes that support foreign workers and mobility in the region. Learn more at the ASEAN+3 site for regional initiatives and support services. The organization provides resources on worker rights, visa renewal support, and cultural integration programs for SSW candidates.
